channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Chuck Daly | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Chuck Daly from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Doug Moe on Chuck Daly
item.description:
“I am incredibly honored to be named the 2018 recipient of the Chuck Daly Lifetime Achievement Award. Winning this award carries a special significance because Chuck was a good friend and a tough competitor. But when the game was over, it was over, and we both appreciated that,”

Doug Moe on Chuck Daly, Jun 4, 2018. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Chuck Daly
item.description:
Rick Carlisle:

“My great friend and mentor Chuck Daly once compared NBA coaching to being the pilot of an aircraft navigating through the turbulence that inevitably comes with any NBA season.'An NBA head coach's job,' as Chuck so succinctly said, 'is at the end of the season to safely land the plane...' I'm gonna keep working on my landings.”

Rick Carlisle on Chuck Daly, Jul 27, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Charles Barkley on Chuck Daly
item.description:
“Chuck Daly [the Dream Team coach] paid me the greatest compliment I ever got in my life,”

Charles Barkley on Chuck Daly, Jul 25, 2012. Source: SI.com.
